notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Combine Guildmage by paying {2} and tapping it.
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
